about: When an open conversation's newest message counts as seen, which reads the conversation. Edges are in points down the conversation's screen: the message's top and bottom, and the screen's. A message is seen once any part of it is on screen, so a message taller than the screen reads as soon as it shows, not when its end scrolls into view.

seen.name: A message wholly on screen is seen
A message taller than the screen is seen once its top shows
A message whose end alone shows is seen
A message reaching past both edges is seen
A message below the screen is not seen
A message starting at the screen's bottom edge is not seen
A message ending at the screen's top edge is not seen
